name: Flowcairn
tagline: Stack the busywork. Let it flow.
positioning: Flowcairn is the calm, visual automation platform that lets operations teams stack small, dependable workflow steps into systems they can trust, without writing code.
audience: Operations leads, founders and team managers at 10 to 250 person companies who juggle many tools and want reliable automation they can read at a glance.
strategy: Own 'calm reliability' in a category that usually sells speed and hype. Every touchpoint uses the stacked-stones metaphor: each automation step is a stone, balanced deliberately on the one below, so the product feels understandable and safe. Content is product-led, showing real-looking workflow diagrams and step sequences rather than abstract promises.

contrastPairs.use: button labels and text on teal panels
labels on amber pills and highlights
amber eyebrows and numbers on dark

fonts.mono: none (Source Sans 3 with tabular figures for data)

designSystem.spacing: 8px base unit; section padding 96px desktop / 64px mobile; generous whitespace around diagrams
designSystem.radius: Pill and stone radii: fully rounded ends (height / 2) for steps and buttons, 24 to 40px for panels
designSystem.borders: Hairline 1-2px ink at 12-15% opacity; dashed teal connectors for workflow links
designSystem.imagery: Original vector workflow diagrams, stacked stones, dotted canvas grids and soft contour hills; no photography
designSystem.shapes: Slightly rotated rounded rectangles (stones), small circular nodes, bezier connector paths with arrowheads
designSystem.buttons: Pill buttons: solid teal with white label for primary, ink outline for secondary, amber reserved for highlights
designSystem.cards: Stone cards with rounded ends, lichen or white fills, gentle 1 to 3 degree rotation in hero contexts, flat in data contexts
designSystem.motifs: Stacked rounded stones logo, node-and-connector workflow diagrams, flowing dashed paths, cairns that grow with each step

artDirection: Lead every creative with a workflow you could actually build: stones are steps, connectors are logic, and the stack always reads bottom-up or top-down in order. Keep the canvas calm, using Mist or Lichen backgrounds with a dotted grid, and reserve Trail Amber for the single most important stone or call to action. Headlines are short, confident Lexend statements; supporting copy explains the mechanism in plain words. Dark Deep Moss compositions are reserved for data-led and thought-leadership pieces.
